clue.text: Bag deposited outside hotel building

indicators.note: something deposited outside another thing ends up surrounding it, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: a sack is a large bag

clue.text: Exercises to get little girl holding position standing on head

taken as written

clue.text: Embarrassed over hotel making mistake that detracts from the main issue

clue.text: End of July, crop-growing area — farmer's beginning to go out for produce

clue.text: Stuff offered by singing family in G&S

taken as written
the two initials of Gilbert and Sullivan

clue.text: Showed unhappiness with two-wheeled vehicle

the letter removed
